title: A launch plan for an AI assistant: three powerful keys in the hosting platform's environment variables treated as safe because they are encrypted, a billing alert standing in for a spending limit, and a rotation plan that is one sentence

planted.why: rotation is one sentence: no owner, no issuer access, no list of consumers, no verification that the old key stops working, and nothing shows it can be done within an hour
an alert reports spending after the fact; it does not stop an abused full-access key from spending, and nothing enforces a limit or scopes the key

encryption at rest does not remove the platform (and its build service and staff) from the parties that can obtain usable copies; the plan lists no third-party holders and one key serves both staging and production

proof.shell:
python3 - <<'PYEND'
t = open('plan.md').read()
assert 'billing alert' in t and 'We will rotate keys if we ever suspect a leak.' in t and 'encrypted' in t
assert 'cap' not in t.lower().split('cost and abuse controls')[1].split('##')[0]
PYEND
